reasons: Cited paragraphs support the compliant classification: 12.3 affirmatively confirms no exclusivity, non-compete, field-of-use or territory restriction binds Customer, matching the preferred position.
The only competitive restraint (12.4) binds Vendor for our benefit, which the rule's detection guidance expressly treats as acceptable, so no flag is warranted.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding, and the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
Rationale is accurate and does not overreach (correctly notes the licence-use limits in 13.4 are ordinary use restrictions, not business restraints).
